title: Pupils
description: One row of the supplier's (LDS) KS4 Autumn pupil file, transcribed from the LDS Data Spec tab 'KS4 Pupil Autumn Data (Restruc)' (reviewed 24/06/2026). Field references are the CSV headers; the 'Column heading provided on file' is the heading of the CSV a school downloads, in column order A-BM. The EBacc fields the specification marks removed (2026) have no column and are left out. MATCHREF is in the LDS ingress file but has no column in the school's download. Like the results schemas, it sets no maxLength.

descriptions.401: Pupil on roll and included in key stage 4 (both NOR and results).
descriptions.403: Pupil added back. Included in key stage 4 (both NOR and results).
descriptions.414: Year group adjusted to 11. Pupil reported as Year 10 or below last year. Included in key stage 4 NOR and results.
descriptions.421: Pupil assumed to be on your roll. Included in key stage 4 data.
descriptions.431: Year group adjusted to 11. Pupil reported as Year 10 or below last year. Included in key stage 4 NOR and results.
descriptions.402: Pupil not on roll and omitted from all figures to be published.
descriptions.404: Pupil on roll. Pupil is not at the end of key stage 4 and is omitted from key stage 4 data.
descriptions.407: Pupil admitted following permanent exclusion from a maintained school. Omitted from NOR and results data.
descriptions.408: Pupil on roll. Pupil aged 15 admitted following permanent exclusion from a maintained school. Omitted from key stage 4.
descriptions.410: Pupil on roll but dual-registered with another school and is published elsewhere.
descriptions.412: Pupil on roll but removed on request from school. Omitted from all data.
descriptions.413: Year group adjusted to 12. Pupil previously reported as end of key stage 4. Omitted from all data.
descriptions.422: Pupil assumed to be on your roll. Pupil is estimated not to be in year 11. Omitted from key stage 4.
descriptions.425: Pupil not on roll and removed from all performance measures.
descriptions.430: Year group adjusted to 12. Pupil previously reported as end of key stage 4. Omitted from all data.

INCLUDED.description: Stamped by ingress from x-ingress.inclusion: true when P_INCL is an included code. Not a supplier column, so not downloaded or shown.

INCLUDABLE.description: Stamped by ingress: true when a school may ask to include this pupil, that is, the pupil is not included. Not a supplier column, so not downloaded or shown.

CANDNO.description: A number allocated to each pupil within each school

CYPMD_ID.description: A pupil reference number for use in the checking exercise

MATCHREF.description: Unique pupil identifier for NPD assigned during matching (Learner_Matched_ID). In the LDS ingress file, but not in the CSV a school downloads.

DOB.description: Pupil date of birth. The specification gives DD/MM/YYYY; YYYY-MM-DD is also read. Shown and downloaded as DD/MM/YYYY.

ENTRYDAT.description: Pupil admission date to school. The specification gives DD/MM/YYYY; YYYY-MM-DD is also read. Shown and downloaded as DD/MM/YYYY.

AGE.description: Pupil age at the start of the school year (31 August 2025)

P_INCL.description: Pupil Inclusion Status flag. See x-ingress.inclusion for the codes.

P_INCL_DESC.description: Pupil Inclusion Status description. The specification gives no field reference; the name is the one the KS4 June file uses. Ingress stamps it from x-ingress.inclusion when the file leaves it blank.

INP8CALC.description: Pupil included in progress 8 calculations. 1 = Yes, 0 = No. Set to null in 2025 and 2026: there is no KS2 prior attainment data from 2020 and 2021 (Covid).

UPN.description: Unique Pupil Number. May be incorrect or missing: it is not yet used directly in the calculation of performance data.

LANG1ST.description: First language: ENG = English, ENB = not known but believed English, OTH = other than English, OTB = not known but believed other than English, REF = refused, NOT = not known.

SENF.description: Special Educational Needs status: K = SEN support, E = EHC plan, N = no recorded SEN.

FSM6_P.description: Pupil recorded as eligible for free school meals in any termly or annual census from the Summer census (May) 2020 up to and including the Spring census (January) 2026. 1 = Yes, 0 = No.

x-csv.heading: Has the pupil been eligible for FSM in the last 6 years?

x-display.label: Has the pupil been eligible for FSM in the last 6 years?

CLA_PP_1_DAY.description: Pupil looked after for one day or more between 1/4/25 and 31/3/26, aged 4 to 15. 1 = Yes, 0 = No.

FSM6CLA1A.description: Pupil is disadvantaged: eligible for free school meals (as FSM6_P), looked after (as CLA_PP_1_DAY), or adopted from care. 1 = Yes, 0 = No.

EALGRP.description: English as an additional language group: 1 = English as first language, 2 = EAL, 3 = unclassified, null = non-PLASC school.

PRIORBAND.description: Prior attainment band at KS2: 1 = below expected, 2 = at expected, 3 = higher standard, 4 = PLASC school with no KS2, null = non-PLASC school. Set to null in 2025 and 2026: there is no KS2 prior attainment data from 2020 and 2021 (Covid).

NEWMOBILE.description: Did the pupil join within the last 2 years (12/09/2024 or later)? 1 = Yes, 0 = No.

x-csv.heading: Did the pupil join within the last 2 yrs?

x-display.label: Did the pupil join within the last 2 yrs?

L2BASICS_94.description: Has the pupil achieved standard 9-4 passes in both English and maths GCSEs? 1 = Yes, null = No.

L2BASICS_95.description: Has the pupil achieved strong 9-5 passes in both English and maths GCSEs? 1 = Yes, null = No.

L2BASICS_97.description: Has the pupil achieved 9-7 passes in both English and maths GCSEs? 1 = Yes, null = No.

ENTRY_E_3NG_PTQ_EE.description: Number of GCSE or equivalent entries in qualifications approved for use pre-16

ENTRY_G_PTQ_EE.description: Total number of GCSE only (including Applied) entries

tripleSci_E.description: Has the pupil been entered for triple science (biology, chemistry and physics)? 1 = Yes, 0 = No.

multiLan_E.description: Has the pupil been entered for multiple EBacc languages? 1 = Yes, 0 = No.
